rows.rationale: Image 2 shows a usable animal crop of a medium-large solid light-coated dog with fluffy/curly coat drinking from a bowl. Coat color/pattern, size, build, leg length and body proportions match Biscuit's apricot goldendoodle description. Head shape and tail carriage are consistent with floppy-eared doodle type with no contradictory markings, size, or ear/tail structure despite heavy grain/low resolution.

Both show a medium-large light-coated dog with fluffy/curly build and similar proportions. Image 2 is grayscale heavily grainy/blurry but shows a quadruped with light tone consistent with apricot/cream, stocky body and fluffy legs, head-down posture like Image 1. No contradictory color pattern, size, or build difference is visible; ears/tail not resolvable but silhouette is broadly consistent with a goldendoodle like Biscuit.

Image 2 shows a light-toned medium-large quadruped with shaggy/curly-appearing coat. Lightness in grayscale is compatible with apricot/cream coat in Image 1, build/size similar to goldendoodle, no contradictory dark pattern or morphology. Heavy grain and monochrome prevent confirmation of ears/tail/markings, so cannot definitively ID but cannot exclude Biscuit.

Image 1 shows an apricot/cream curly-coated medium-large doodle with floppy ears. Image 2 (t9_f383.jpg) is extremely grainy, low-resolution, and unusable - no clear animal, coat color/pattern, curly coat, ear/tail shape, or build can be discerned to match Biscuit.

Image 1 reference is apricot curly-coated medium-large dog with floppy ears consistent with goldendoodle. Image 2 detection shows a dog with tall upright erect pointed ears and short straight coat, not curly and not floppy. Ear shape and coat texture are robust mismatches, so Image 2 cannot be Biscuit.

Image 2 is a severely degraded, high-noise grayscale crop with no clear animal silhouette. Coat color/pattern, size/build, markings, and ear/tail shape cannot be assessed, so it cannot be matched to the apricot curly-coated medium-large goldendoodle with floppy ears in Image 1. Unusable crop.

Ear/head shape and build also do not show doodle characteristics. Attributes are inconsistent with Biscuit.
